# verl runtime

Runtime package and build metadata from [verl](https://github.com/verl-project/verl),
version 0.9.0, revision `483b8a009ba3a97563edee3a19887e4862b8094a`.

HRP's Exact-PG training uses `TrainingWorker`, `BaseEngine`, and AdamW construction.
The runtime source is unchanged. Examples, tests, documentation, and development
tools are omitted from this distribution.
